# Indriya Temple Jewellery

> A student concept project about temple-inspired gold jewellery, including bridal styles, design information, and frequently asked questions. Not an official Indriya store; no product availability, prices, policies, or guarantees are asserted.

## Pages

- [Varalakshmi Vratham Gold Jewellery](/varalakshmi-vratham-gold-jewellery): The main landing page — sacred-celebration jewellery categories, craftsmanship notes, trust and store links, and jewellery FAQs.
- [Temple Jewellery Guide](/temple-jewellery-guide): An educational guide to temple jewellery motifs, South Indian bridal styling, and practical care, with sources.
- [About This Page](/about): Who created this student concept page, how it was researched, and how to contact the creator.
- [Contact](/contact): How to reach the creator of this page by phone.
